summary.text: Collin Duel was elected in 2022 to represent House District 31 in the Oklahoma House of Representatives. A former U.S. Army Ranger and practicing attorney, he is vice chair of the Judiciary and Public Safety Oversight Committee.

paragraphs.text: Duel served in the 3rd Ranger Battalion with four combat deployments to Afghanistan and was honorably discharged in 2013 as a sergeant.
He was awarded two Army Commendation Medals.
He earned undergraduate and law degrees from the University of Oklahoma and has practiced law since 2017.
He and his wife live in Guthrie and are raising four children.
